title: Cotton Face Scrubbies
description: A tiny reusable round that gives beginners another fast win with increases.
expectationText: A low-pressure mini project where you make a soft reusable round and practice keeping increases even.

steps.title: Make the center
steps.instruction: Start with a magic ring or chain 4 and join into a loop.

steps.title: Round 1
steps.instruction: Work 8 single crochet into the center ring and join with a slip stitch.

steps.title: Round 2
steps.instruction: Work 2 single crochet into each stitch around for 16 stitches total.

steps.title: Round 3
steps.instruction: Alternate 1 single crochet, then 2 single crochet in the next stitch around.

steps.title: Finish the edge
steps.instruction: Slip stitch around the edge, fasten off, and weave in the ends.
